instruction: Make a new public playlist from all my liked songs from my Spotify song, album and playlist libraries, and share its URL with my wife via phone text message.
notes: Songs are abstracted into representatives: song-a (song library), song-b (an album in the album library), song-c (a playlist in the playlist library), all liked, plus song-d (in song library but not liked) to show the liked filter. Sources (song library, albums, playlists) share supertype 'source'; a song can be added only after its source's songs were listed and the liked list was retrieved. show_album_library / show_playlist_library carry an extra non-API parameter naming the library entry whose id becomes known (one listing call reveals all entries; with several entries the planner repeats the step). The created playlist's URL (shareable_link) is obtained by show_playlist on the new playlist and must be embedded in the text message sent to the contact with relationship 'wife'. Goal records (new-playlist, song-a/b/c, wife-contact, playlist-url-message) are declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can require exactly the goal conditions. token-for/username-for static facts pin each app's credentials and token object.

plan: (phone-send-text-message wife-phone-number playlist-url-message phone-token wife-contact new-playlist-url new-playlist)
